findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mappu_search_public_travel, mappu_get_audio_guide · Private data: mappu_search_public_travel, mappu_read_public_page · Public sink: mappu_save_trip_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mappu_search_public_travel, mappu_get_audio_guide · Private data: mappu_search_public_travel, mappu_read_public_page · Public sink: mappu_save_trip_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
